decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app sits close to the core dental practice software and was launched as a dedicated product line, so the firm's related knowledge and in-house R&D let it interpret results and keep improving it.
The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and its practitioner relationships, so it reinforces the core business and is likely retained.
The remote screen-sharing tool is an integral part of customer support for the software, which the firm understands well and which became even more relevant with remote work.
The performance analytics dashboard draws directly on the practice data the firm's software already manages, so it fits its knowledge base and supports the digital-practice strategy.
The complete practice bundle repackages the established offer, so the firm can easily assess and adjust it, although such bundles are sometimes restructured.

A job and practice listing portal lies far from the software competence, faces network-effect competition, and was only mentioned on the website, so the firm can hardly learn from it and would likely redirect resources to its core.
